To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the virtualization mechanism is a powerful means of realizing business-oriented service abstraction in the context of Web services.

1) the virtualization mechanism is a useful tool for service abstraction; 2) the virtualization can be used for service composition; 3) the virtualization is a good approach for service discovery; 4) virtualized Web services are a good way for service deployment and management.

the business-oriented service abstraction is a useful and effective approach to Web services virtualization, which can be used to realize the virtualization of Web services in an e-scien- ce environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: 1) how to abstract and virtualize a set of Web services into a business-oriented service; 2) how to realize the business-oriented service in a distributed environment, and to support the business process; and 3) how to evaluate the performance of a business-oriented service in terms of the virtualized Web services and the business process.

the following issues: (1) How to abstract and encapsulate Web services in a way that is suitable for business users; (2) How to virtualize and integrate Web services for business users; and (3) How to realize the virtualization and integration for business users.

the following questions: How can we provide users a uniform, abstract view on a set of heterogeneous Web services? How can we enable controlled sharing of Web services? And, how can we realize the virtualization of Web services in an e-scientific research environment?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

virtualization of web services is a powerful tool for business-oriented abstraction of web services, which can be used to realize a more uniform view of heterogeneous and un- ordered web services, to simplify and standardize the use of web services and to provide users a more abstract and unified view of a set of fine grained, heterogeneous web services, and to enable the sharing and isolation of the underlying services.
the proposed approach is able to provide a more abstract view on a set of heterogeneous and un-organized Web services, which is more suitable for business-oriented service abstraction.
the proposed virtualization approach is a viable and useful way to improve service usability and interoperability in the bioinformatics research environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed and implemented a Web service virtualization framework, which is able to virtualize Web services and to provide a business-oriented view of the Web service virtualization.
we have developed a practical approach for the business-oriented virtualization of Web services.
virtualization is a promising way to realize a business-oriented abstraction of Web services.
The main takeaway from our work is that

virtualization can be applied as a mechanism to improve the quality of service in an environment with heterogeneous and distributed resources, and can be a useful technique for service abstraction and composition.
virtualization of Web services is not just a technology, but a new way of thinking about the way we use Web services in a business context.
virtualization can be used to hide the complexity of a set of Web services, and to provide users with a single image of a service that can be invoked in a simple and transparent way.
